{{Price|20|gem}} for 4 Pressure Nozzles |sellprice = 200 |quality = false }} A '''Pressure Nozzle''' is a sprinkler upgrade that increases the watering range of [[Crafting#Sprinklers|Sprinklers]]. The range is increased to: *[[Sprinkler]]: 3x3 (now reaches the corner tiles) *[[Quality Sprinkler]]: 5x5 *[[Iridium Sprinkler]]: 7x7 Pressure Nozzles can be purchased in [[Qi's Walnut Room]] at a cost of {{Price|20|Gem}} for 4 nozzles, and rarely drop from monsters in the Skull Cavern during the [[Quests#Qi's Hungry Challenge|Qi's Hungry Challenge]] or [[Quests#Skull Cavern Invasion|Skull Cavern Invasion]] quests. Additionally, [[Slimes]] may rarely drop it when slain in [[The Mines]] during [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep quest]] or after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]]. A sprinkler may not be equipped with both a pressure nozzle and an [[Enricher]] at the same time. ''Note: While the item icon shows only one nozzle, it is sufficient to upgrade one entire sprinkler (one Pressure Nozzle covers all 4 sprinkler nozzles).'' [[File:PressureNozzleSprinklers.png|thumb|left|A Pressure Nozzle applied to each type of sprinkler]] [[File:PressureNozzleDemo.png|thumb|left|All Sprinklers with and without Pressure Nozzles]]{{Clear}} ==Tip== When using pressure nozzles on [[Iridium Sprinkler]]s, it is possible to automatically water the entire [[Greenhouse#Sprinklers|greenhouse]] while leaving only a single tile unplanted. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} [[Category:Special items]] [[de:Druck-Drüse]] [[es:Boquilla a presión]] [[fr:Buse de projection]] [[it:Bocchetta ad alta pressione]] [[ja:圧力ノズル]] [[ko:고압 노즐]] [[hu:Nagy szórófej]] [[pt:Bocal de Pressão]] [[ru:Нагнетательное сопло]] [[tr:Basınç Memesi]] [[zh:加压喷头]]
